blogs.title: The Great Mimickers: Distinguishing Cystic Leiomyomas from Endometriomas in Pregnancy
blogs.description: This post explores the diagnostic challenges of differentiating between large cystic leiomyomas and decidualized endometriomas in a pregnant patient. We will analyze the sonographic and MRI features—such as wall thickness, vascularity, and solid components—that help clinicians navigate these overlapping presentations and avoid misdiagnosis.

blogs.title: Navigating the CA-125 Conundrum: Tumor Markers in the Gravid Patient
blogs.description: Tumor markers in pregnancy are notoriously tricky due to physiological fluctuations. This post discusses the specific behavior of CA-125 across trimesters, why isolated measurements are often unhelpful, and how to interpret 'slight' elevations in the context of complex abdominal masses.

blogs.title: Surgical Triage: When to Intervene on Symptomatic Abdominal Masses
blogs.description: When does the risk of a mass outweigh the risk of surgery? We examine the decision-making process for surgical intervention in pregnancy, focusing on 'red flags' like torsion, ischemia, and mechanical dyspnea (steric bulk) versus the benefits of a conservative, expectant management approach.

blogs.title: Imaging Safety: Maximizing Yield with Non-Contrast MRI in Pregnancy
blogs.description: Given the limitations of gadolinium-enhanced MRI in pregnancy, how can we still achieve high-quality diagnostic clarity? This post reviews the utility of non-contrast MRI, the importance of T1 and T2 fat-sat weighting, and how to leverage ultrasound as a primary screening tool for myoma location.

blogs.title: From Myomectomy to Delivery: Obstetric Planning for Large Uterine Masses
blogs.description: The management of a large mass doesn't end with the primary surgery. This blog covers the long-term obstetric considerations, including the impact of large pelvic myomas on the expulsive phase of labor, the necessity of elective caesarean delivery, and monitoring fetal growth in the presence of residual masses.
